onChange.script:
self.custom.tab = 'home'
	want = self.params.tab
	if want in ('home', 'config', 'diagnostics', 'alarms', 'interlocks', 'info'):
		self.custom.tab = want
	self.custom.message = ''
	self.custom.pending = {'active': False, 'device': '', 'path': '', 'member': '', 'value': 0, 'text': ''}
	self.custom.refused = False

self.custom.tab = 'home'
	want = currentValue.value
	if want in ('home', 'config', 'diagnostics', 'alarms', 'interlocks', 'info'):
		self.custom.tab = want

config.script:
p = self.view.custom.pending
	msg = cadre.hmi.command(self.session, p.path, self.view.params.deviceId, p.member, p.value)
	self.view.custom.pending = {'active': False, 'device': '', 'path': '', 'member': '', 'value': 0, 'text': ''}
	self.view.custom.message = msg

config.expression: if({view.custom.refused}, 'Start refused: ', if({view.custom.ilk.interlocked}, 'Interlocked: ', 'Start not permitted: ')) + if({view.custom.ilk.unsatisfied} > 0, toStr({view.custom.ilk.unsatisfied}) + ' condition' + if({view.custom.ilk.unsatisfied} = 1, '', 's') + ' not met', 'reset required')

config.script: self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W1', 'member': 'cmd', 'value': False, 'text': self.props.text + ': ' + self.session.custom.selectedTitle + '?'}

m = self.view.custom.dev.take
	self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W2', 'member': 'mode', 'value': m.value, 'text': 'Take control: ' + m.name + '?'}

m = self.view.custom.dev.release
	self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W2', 'member': 'mode', 'value': m.value, 'text': 'Release: ' + m.name + '?'}

m = self.view.custom.dev.maintain
	self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W2', 'member': 'mode', 'value': m.value, 'text': 'Maintenance: ' + m.name + '?'}

transforms.code:
parts = (value or '').split('|')
	if len(parts) < 3 or not parts[0]:
		return []
	return [dict({'member': 'speedSp', 'label': 'Speed setpoint (%)', 'path': 'W3', 'format': '0.0', 'minimum': 0, 'maximum': 100}, deviceId=parts[0], enabled=parts[1] == '1', unit=parts[2])]

config.script: self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W5', 'member': 'fault', 'value': False, 'text': self.props.text + ': ' + self.session.custom.selectedTitle + '?'}

transforms.code:
parts = (value or '').split('|')
	return cadre.hmi.config_rows(self.session, parts[0], len(parts) > 1 and parts[1] == '1')
